implementation_review.result_summary: All 11 native level shifts, 1 Sludge addition and 4 extension learners match exactly in profiles/movesets/catalogs. All 313 existing base_stats are unchanged. Every active Poison/Steel species has a 40+ power level-up STAB option; early bases receive Acid/MetalClaw, while physical Barricant/Castanake/Mosquitan receive PoisonJab at levels 32/32/46. No further mandatory coverage patch found; late evolutions and the pseudo-legendary mature later.

defensive_spread_audit.status: source and native-chart reviewed; final Fairy pack validation owned by root
defensive_spread_audit.native_chart_source: Verified northwoods-moves-v6.crystalpack GameDataSet.type_effectiveness; 108 ordinary entries plus 2 Foresight-sensitive immunities; normal battles without Foresight. All 289 native single-type cells exactly match the known Gen2 chart. No raw pack data is committed.
defensive_spread_audit.method: Multiply dual defenses, counting each attack type once per species. Before uses the same active220 IDs with backed-up old typings and actual native Gen2 chart. After uses approved13 retypes, Fairy column and removal of Steel Dark/Ghost resistances. The same17 comparison isolates roster/Steel changes; after18 also includes the new attack type. No stats, speed, availability, STAB power, abilities, items or usage weighting are assumed.
interpretation: Overall weakness incidence stays essentially flat after adding the eighteenth attack type: 751/3740 (20.0802%) native cells versus 792/3960 (20.0000%) after. Mean weaknesses per species rise from 3.4136 to 3.6 because there is one more attack type. On the same 17 attack types, weaknesses slightly fall from 751 to 749; resistance cells fall from 955 to 923, and immunities rise from 143 to 150.

Fairy meaningfully targets the requested strong cohorts: 9/11 Dragons, 18/23 Dark and 20/22 Fighting species are Fairy-weak. Two Dragon/Fighting and two Dark/Fighting species are 4x weak; the four Fighting 4x species overlap those Dragon/Dark cohorts and must not be counted twice. Pelletank and Taconarch are Fairy-neutral rather than automatically weak just because they are Dragon.

Poison targets expand from 25 to 31 super-effective species; Steel from 27 to 37. All 19 Poison species resist Fairy (17 half, 2 quarter). Nineteen of 21 Steel species resist Fairy; two Steel/Dragon species remain neutral. Among the 13 new Fairies, 8 are Poison-weak and 12 Steel-weak; two Grass/Fairy species take 4x Poison, two Ice/Fairy 4x Steel. These distinct dual-type risks preserve counterplay.

Steel is still robust but pays a real defensive cost: its 21 members have 50 weakness cells before and 54 after; the same 17-type resistance cells decline from 208 to 171 before 19 new Fairy resistances bring the 18-type total to 190. Steel/Ghost Doublehex and Wreckquiem become 2x weak to both Dark and Ghost. The nerf also improves Dark/Ghost offense against Steel, so it is not a pure Dark nerf.

Dragon STAB keeps 9 super-effective targets but gains 13 immune targets. Dark super-effective targets fall from 32 to 24 despite Steel resistance removal because several Psychic typings become Fairy. Fighting targets fall from 66 to 64; Fairy is a targeted extra answer, not removal of every existing matchup. Crowscare gains a real 2x Fairy weakness and no active species remains without a type weakness.

Type-only accounting is not a metagame simulation. Stats are unchanged; move power/category, speed, encounter placement, held items, prediction, and level progression remain relevant. The proposed encounter timing remains a plan, not verified map authoring.
